items.title: Ebola: Virologists urge Nigerians to embrace hygiene as current strain defies treatment
items.summary: Renowned virologists urge Nigerians to embrace hygiene as a case of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, which has no approved vaccine or treatment, is confirmed. Read More: https://punchng.com/ebola-virologis
